M18-C2 — operator-visible budget-gate health for this run.

``degraded=true`` means at least one budget decision on this run was
made FAIL-CLOSED because the money store was unreachable (denial shaped
like an outage, never silently opened). ``warned=true`` (M23-B) means at
least one ALLOWED decision crossed the near-cap warning threshold — the
operator sees the walk toward the cap before the hard stop. Absent/false
= healthy / far from the cap.

post.description:
Materialize the canned demo for the CALLER'S team (M19-N4 / C10).

One project + repo binding + one COMPLETED run carrying its real diff,
real review verdict and real PR binding, replayed from recorded material.
Zero provider keys involved. Idempotent: repeat calls return the same
demo graph. Every persisted payload carries the replay marker.

{goal} → 201 {planId, plan}. Mints a fresh run + plan, leaves the run at
AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL via sm.plan_proposed() (state_machine vocabulary).

`/plans/{id}/approve` → 200 {runId}. admin/engineer only. Idempotent.

M12-F2: the durable decision is a compare-and-swap on agent_plans.version.
The CAS runs BEFORE any in-memory mutation, so a loser of the race leaves
planner/state-machine/memory untouched and gets 409 PLAN_ALREADY_DECIDED
instead of both callers believing they won (last-write-wins eliminated).
A sequential re-approve still short-circuits to the same runId.

`/plans/{id}/reject` → 202. Persisted AND audited. admin/engineer only.

M12-F2: same CAS-before-memory discipline as approve. The decision window
is AWAITING_PLAN_APPROVAL — a plan that already moved (approved, rejected,
executing) rejects with 409 PLAN_ALREADY_DECIDED, so reject-after-reject
and mixed approve/reject races resolve to exactly one winner.

get.description:
List the caller's team's runs, newest first (contract M10-C2).

Cursor pagination per api-conventions.md: pass ``nextCursor`` back as
``?cursor=`` for the next page. ``?offset=`` is accepted but IGNORED
during the one-release deprecation window (M14-W4 F3a).

Single-run aggregate read — pair-contract W4-C2 (M14-W4 F3a).

Wire shape ``{runId, state, costUsd?, prId?, url?, steps?}`` plus the
legacy status fields (superset of ``/status``). Nullability is explicit:
``costUsd`` is None until cost_ledger rows exist for the run; ``prId``/
``url`` stay None until S2's PR-open producer binds one; ``steps`` lists
the run's agent_events as ordered ``{seq, type, ts}`` summaries, capped at
the LAST 100 (wire order = seq order). Unknown runs and foreign teams'
runs both answer 404 NOT_FOUND with the identical frozen error envelope
(M13-G5a no-oracle law).
